title: Pulse targets configuration
description: The only file you edit to add, remove or retune a monitored project.

$schema.description: Editor hint. Keep it as ./targets.schema.json for IDE autocomplete.

targets.description: One entry per monitored project. Adding a project means adding one object here.

secretRef.description: A literal value, or a ${SECRET_NAME} reference resolved from the environment at runtime.

urlish.description: An absolute http(s) URL, or a ${SECRET_NAME} reference.

retries.description: Retries after the first attempt. 2 means up to 3 attempts total.

expectStatus.description: Acceptable HTTP status code, or list of them.

defaults.description: Applied to every target unless the target overrides the field.

concurrency.description: Maximum checks in flight at once.

jitterMs.description: Each check waits a random 0..jitterMs before its first attempt, so twenty projects are not hit in the same millisecond.

backoffBaseMs.description: First retry delay. Doubles each retry, capped at backoffMaxMs.

backoffMaxMs.description: Upper bound on any single backoff delay.

id.description: Unique slug, used as the dashboard key and as the prefix of this project's secret names. Renaming it starts the history over.

name.description: Display name shown on the dashboard.

type.description: Check implementation. Each value maps to exactly one file in src/checks/.

tier.description: daily = checked once a day. frequent = ALSO checked every ~10 minutes, for Render's 15-minute spin-down. Every enabled target is checked by the daily run, so every target has history.

enabled.description: Set false to park a target without deleting its history.

platform.description: Free-text label shown on the dashboard, for example: vercel+supabase

publicUrl.description: Optional. The dashboard card links here.

notes.description: What this check actually touches. Shown on the dashboard card.

requiredSecrets.description: Every ${SECRET} used by this target must be listed here, and everything listed here must be used. Validation enforces both directions.

headers.description: type=http: extra request headers. Values may be ${SECRET} references.

body.description: type=http: request body. Objects are JSON-encoded and sent as application/json.

expectBodyContains.description: type=http: substring the response body must contain. Use this so a cached 200 from a CDN cannot pass as a healthy database.

apiKey.description: type=supabase: the anon key. Use a ${SECRET} reference - this repo is public.

table.description: type=supabase: table to select from. Default: heartbeat

column.description: type=supabase: column used in the select. Default: id. It must exist on the table.

connectionString.description: type=mongo: mongodb+srv URI. This MUST be a ${SECRET} reference - it contains a password.

dbName.description: type=mongo: database to run the ping command against. Default: admin
